# BackscatteringImmunity

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A property of topological edge states that prevents reflection of light at bends, disorder, or fabrication imperfections, ensuring unidirectional propagation. Eliminates signal integrity issues in dense optical networks, enabling higher bandwidth and lower latency in TCC architectures.
